TaskOverview_733.en: Go to the central <color=#orange>Demonic Tower</color> and slay the Wicked Associate

TaskOverview_733.ru: Идите в центральный <color=#orange>Демоническая башня</color> и убей злого сообщника

TaskOverview_735.en: Rescue the Captives in the five <color=#orange>Demonic Towers</color>
TaskOverview_735.cn: 救出五座<color=#orange>魔塔</color>中的俘虏

TaskOverview_737.en: Activate the <color=#orange>Demonic Energy-tainted Altar</color> to change the Demonic Qi state of this place
TaskOverview_737.cn: 激活<color=#orange>魔气祭坛</color>改变此地魔气状态

TaskOverview_738.en: Put on the <color=#orange>Beyond the Dome Stealth Cloak</color> and blend into the gathering
TaskOverview_738.cn: 穿上<color=#orange>天幕隐衣</color>混入集会
TaskOverview_738.ru: Наденьте <color=#orange>За куполом-невидимкой</color> и смешаться с толпой

TaskOverview_741.en: Participate in the activities in the arena to gain <color=#orange>Sect Approval</color>
TaskOverview_741.cn: 参与场中活动以获得<color=#orange>门派青睐</color>
TaskOverview_741.ru: Участвуйте в мероприятиях на арене, чтобы получить <color=#orange>Утверждение Секты</color>

TaskOverview_742.en: Go to the trial grounds to complete the <color=#orange>Sect Trial</color>
TaskOverview_742.cn: 前往试炼场地完成<color=#orange>门派试炼</color>
TaskOverview_742.ru: Отправляйтесь на площадку для Испытаний, чтобы завершить <color=#orange>Испытание Секты</color>

TaskDescription_0.en: Click tiles within sight where crickets appear to move there. Click the <color=#orange>cricket icon</color> to try to capture it. This will consume 1 <color=#orange>Bug Net</color>. If you miss, don't feel frustrated—move on and keep trying in another tile.
TaskDescription_0.cn: 点击视线内的地块，移动到促织出现的地格后，点击<color=#orange>促织图标</color>，消耗<color=#orange>「捕虫网」</color>捕捉促织。若是一扑未中，不要灰心，再前往下一个出现促织的地格捕捉吧。

TaskDescription_1.en: Go to the place of the <color=#orange>Great Monkey</color> on the edge of the map. Click the Encounter icon to go to the Great Monkey's turf.
TaskDescription_1.cn: 前往地图边缘的<color=#orange>「英雄猴杰」</color>所在地，点击奇遇图标，即可前往猴王藏身之处。

TaskDescription_2.en: Go to the tile <color=#orange>Deep Valley - Bamboo Hut</color>. Click the Encounter icon to initiate <color=#orange>Return to the Bamboo Hut</color>.
TaskDescription_2.cn: 前往地格<color=#orange>「深谷-竹庐」</color>，点击奇遇图标开启<color=#orange>「返回竹庐」</color>奇遇。

TaskDescription_3.en: Go to the <color=#orange>Exit of the Deep Valley</color> on the edge of the map. Click the Encounter icon to leave the Deep Valley.
TaskDescription_3.cn: 前往深谷地图边缘的<color=#orange>「深谷出口」</color>所在地，点击奇遇图标并离开深谷。

TaskDescription_4.en: Go to the place of <color=#orange>Downstream Along the River</color> on the edge of the map. Click the Encounter icon to initiate it.
TaskDescription_4.cn: 前往地图边缘<color=#orange>「顺河而下」</color>所在地，并点击奇遇图标，开启该奇遇。

TaskDescription_5.en: Search the map for the <color=#orange>Secluded Village</color>. There might be a boat that can sail across the hidden river in the village.
TaskDescription_5.cn: 在地图中寻找<color=#orange>「隐秘小村」</color>。不知村落中可有能通过暗河的船只？

TaskDescription_6.en: Search for <color=#orange>potherbs</color> around the village and bring them to the Taoist.
TaskDescription_6.cn: 在小村四周搜寻<color=#orange>野菜</color>，并交付老道士。
TaskDescription_6.ru: Искать <color=#orange>травы</color> обойдите деревню и приведите их к даосу.

TaskDescription_7.en: Search for the <color=#orange>Muscular Young Man</color> and talk to him.
TaskDescription_7.cn: 寻找<color=#orange>壮硕青年</color>，并与其交谈。
TaskDescription_7.ru: Ищите то, что <color=#orange>Мускулистый молодой человек</color> и поговори с ним.

TaskDescription_8.en: You can acquire resources by clicking <color=#orange>Gather</color> and then the <color=#orange>Resource</color> you wish to get when you're on a Resource tile. The quantity of resources you'll get depends on the wealth of the world and the types of abundant resources on each tile.
TaskDescription_8.cn: 处在资源地块时，选择<color=#orange>「采集」</color>，并选择需要采集的<color=#orange>「资源」</color>，即可获得一定数目的对应资源。世界的富庶程度以及不同地块所盛产的资源种类均会影响到某一资源的获取数量。

TaskDescription_9.en: Click the <color=#orange>Industry</color> icon in the Secluded Village to open the Industry Map. Enter the building <color=#orange>Kitchen</color> and add tools, reagents, and foodstuff on the <color=#orange>Craft</color> page to cook a dish.
TaskDescription_9.cn: 点击「隐秘小村」的<color=#orange>产业图标</color>，打开产业地图。进入建筑<color=#orange>「食窖」</color>，在<color=#orange>「制造」</color>界面中添加工具、引子与食材，烹制一道菜肴。

TaskDescription_10.en: Search for the <color=#orange>Noble</color> and talk to them.
TaskDescription_10.ru: Ищите то, что <color=#orange>Благородный</color> и поговори с ними.

TaskDescription_11.en: Return to the <color=#orange>Secluded Village</color> and make a decision.
TaskDescription_11.cn: 返回<color=#orange>「隐秘小村」</color>，再做决定。
TaskDescription_11.ru: Вернитесь к <color=#orange>Уединенная деревня</color> и прими решение.

TaskDescription_12.en: After acquiring the <color=#orange>Sturdy Boat</color>, initiate the <color=#orange>Hidden Mountain River</color> Encounter on the edge of the map to leave this place.
TaskDescription_12.cn: 获得<color=#orange>「牢靠的小船」</color>之后，前往地图边缘的<color=#orange>「山底暗河」</color>奇遇，即可离开此地。

TaskDescription_13.en: Return to the <color=#orange>Secluded Village</color> to acquire the <color=#orange>Sturdy Boat</color>.
TaskDescription_13.cn: 返回<color=#orange>「隐秘小村」</color>，获取物品<color=#orange>「牢靠的小船」</color>。

TaskDescription_14.en: Go to the Encounter: <color=#orange>Hidden Mountain River</color> and use the item <color=#orange>Sturdy Boat</color> to initiate it.
TaskDescription_14.cn: 前往奇遇<color=#orange>「山底暗河」</color>，使用物品<color=#orange>「牢靠的小船」</color>开启奇遇。

TaskDescription_15.en: Search for the <color=#orange>Mischievous Child</color> and talk to them.
TaskDescription_15.cn: 寻找<color=#orange>小顽童</color>，并与其交谈。
TaskDescription_15.ru: Ищите то, что <color=#orange>Озорной ребенок</color> и поговори с ними.

TaskDescription_16.en: Search for <color=#orange>Huanyue</color> and talk to her.

TaskDescription_17.en: Go to the Secluded Village and click the Encounter icon to initiate <color=#orange>Burning Hamlet</color>.
TaskDescription_17.cn: 前往地块「隐秘小村」，点击奇遇图标进入<color=#orange>「村中异变」</color>奇遇。

TaskDescription_18.en: Go to the Encounter: <color=#orange>Hidden Mountain River</color> and use the item <color=#orange>Sturdy Boat</color> to initiate it.
TaskDescription_18.cn: 前往奇遇<color=#orange>「山底暗河」</color>，使用物品<color=#orange>「牢靠的小船」</color>开启奇遇。

TaskDescription_19.en: Search the map, go to the <color=#orange>Way Station</color>, and search for a way to get to <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color>.
TaskDescription_19.cn: 探索地图并前往<color=#orange>「驿站」</color>，寻找抵达<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>的办法。

TaskDescription_20.cn: 探索地图并前往<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>。

TaskDescription_21.en: Click the <color=#orange>Industry icon</color> over the Taiwu Village tile to open the Industry Map. Click the <color=#orange>Construction Space</color> at the bottom right to open the Building page and select the <color=#orange>Taiwu Ancestral Temple</color>. With enough resources, you can select and appoint workers or use Quick Plan to dispatch them automatically. Click Start Construction and select an open ground, and the Ancestral Temple will be rebuilt after several periods.
TaskDescription_21.cn: 在「太吾村」内点击<color=#orange>产业图标</color>，进入产业地图。点击右下角<color=#orange>「建设空间」</color>进入建造界面，选择建筑<color=#orange>「太吾氏祠堂」</color>。当目前持有资源满足建筑消耗所需时，可选择数名建造人手，或点击「快速安排」则系统将自动派遣可用人力实施建造。点击「开始建造」并在产业地图上选择可用空地，再等待一定时节，便可以重建祠堂了。

TaskDescription_23.en: Open <color=#orange>Industry</color> of the Taiwu Village and click Construction Space. Select <color=#orange>Fine Art</color> books on the Study page to unlock buildings based on your study progress. Buildings require Core Materials. Expansion structures need to be built near the base buildings or certain resources. Resource Spots will ripen in different seasons, and certain buildings can help with their growth. You can also remove buildings on the <color=#orange>Demolition Page</color>. After a building or resource is demolished, its space will be available again and part of the resource cost will be refunded.
TaskDescription_23.cn: 进入「太吾村」的<color=#orange>「产业」</color>并点击「建设空间」，建造建筑。在「研读书籍」界面选择<color=#orange>「技艺」</color>书籍，依据阅读进度可以解锁特定建筑，建筑解锁后持有对应「心材」即可建造建筑，扩展建筑需建造在基础建筑或特定资源附近。自然资源在建造完成后可使用心材进行培育，增加其资源产能。建筑及资源点均可<color=#orange>撤除</color>，被撤除后将余出建筑空间，并返还部分资源。

TaskDescription_24.en: Click <color=#orange>Dispatch</color> when you're on a resource tile to dispatch villagers to perform tasks such as administer, guard, or stand by. Only Taiwu villagers can gather resources or relocate resources. You can appoint villagers by clicking on the character icons at the center of the page, or click <color=#orange>Auto-dispatch</color> at the top to appoint random ones. You can select a specific type of resource after dispatching villagers to acquire it every month.
TaskDescription_24.cn: 处于地格时，点击<color=#orange>「派遣」</color>即可派遣太吾村民前往该地格进行监管、守墓、待命等工作。仅太吾村农户可采集资源或迁移资源。点击派遣界面正中的人物图标可指定村民，点击人物图标上方<color=#orange>「自动派遣」</color>，将随机派遣村民。成功派遣村民至此地格后，亦将自动标记此地格。

TaskDescription_25.en: Ask around for the whereabouts of the <color=#orange>Tomb Immortal</color> while managing Taiwu Village. That may take some time...
TaskDescription_25.cn: 打理太吾村之余，探听<color=#orange>「古墓仙人」</color>的踪迹。或许要静心等待一段时日……

TaskDescription_26.en: The legendary <color=#orange>Tomb Immortal</color> really exists! Go to Encounter to find out about it.
TaskDescription_26.cn: 传闻中的<color=#orange>古墓仙人</color>竟然真的存在，这就前往奇遇一探究竟吧。

TaskDescription_28.cn: 在<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>附近，迎战异人。
TaskDescription_28.ru: Сражайтесь с экстраординарными личностями рядом <color=#orange>Деревня Тайу</color>.

TaskDescription_30.en: Return to <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color> and fight Xiangshu Incarnation to unseal the Sword Mound.
TaskDescription_30.cn: 回到<color=#orange>太吾村</color>地区，迎战相枢化身，解封剑冢。

TaskDescription_31.en: Go to <color=#orange>Taiwu Village - Derelict Way Station</color> and initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Derelict Way Station</color>.
TaskDescription_31.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「太吾村-荒废驿站」</color>，进入奇遇<color=#orange>「荒废驿站」</color>。

TaskDescription_32.en: You can travel to sects to which you have established Way Stations in the <color=#orange>World Map</color> above the map at the bottom right. You must spend Silver and time to arrive at a sect's location, and the cost goes up with the travel distance. It will cost extra time if you don't have enough Silver. You can also travel faster by switching your <color=#orange>Vehicle</color>. If you need to go to or pass by a region to which you haven't established a Way Station, you need to spend <color=#orange>Prestige</color> to establish one first.
TaskDescription_32.cn: 点击右下角地图上方<color=#orange>「世界区域」</color>，在旅行地图界面选择已开通驿站的门派，花费银钱和时间到达门派所在，花费随旅行距离上升。当银钱不足时需消耗额外时间，可通过更换<color=#orange>「代步」</color>缩短旅行时间。若前往或途经尚未开通驿站的地区，需另外消耗<color=#orange>「威望」</color>开通该地区的驿站。

TaskDescription_33.en: Go to the tile where <color=#orange>Shishufu</color> is and talk to him for info.
TaskDescription_33.cn: 前往<color=#orange>室述辅</color>所在地格，与其对话获得信息。
TaskDescription_33.ru: Перейдите к плитке, где <color=#orange>Шишуфу</color> есть и поговорите с ним за информацией.

TaskDescription_34.en: Go to the tile of the <color=#orange>Sword Mound</color> and initiate the Encounter: unseal the Sword Mound and fight the enemy. The fight will be challenging, so be prepared...
TaskDescription_34.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢」</color>所在地块，进入奇遇，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。战斗尤为凶险，当事先做好万全准备……

TaskDescription_35.en: Go to <color=#orange>Monu Weave Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place shrouded in a dark mist with finches hovering above...
TaskDescription_35.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“莫女衣”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处雀鸟盘旋，青烟缭绕，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_36.en: Go to <color=#orange>Spiritsealer Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place devoid of any greenery or vitality...
TaskDescription_36.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“伏邪铁”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处寸草不生，一片煞气，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_37.en: Go to <color=#orange>Dark Frost Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place with a bone-chilling cold...
TaskDescription_37.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“大玄凝”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处滴水成冰，奇寒无比，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_38.en: Go to <color=#orange>Fenghuang Cocoon Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place glittering with a golden light and with the crows of fenghuang...
TaskDescription_38.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“凤凰茧”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处金光灼目，凤凰长鸣，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_39.en: Go to <color=#orange>Ignideus Blaze Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place with an undying, mysterious fire giving out constant cries of sorrow...
TaskDescription_39.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“焚神炼”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处异火不灭，常作悲歌，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_40.en: Go to <color=#orange>Candelor's Tail Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place frequented by serpents and loongs with their fleeting roars...
TaskDescription_40.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“解龙魄”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处蛟蛇出没，隐有龙吟，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_41.en: Go to <color=#orange>Vitalos Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place shrouded alternatively in a magnificent light and an ominous haze...
TaskDescription_41.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“溶尘隐”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处华光阵阵，雾气氤氲，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_42.en: Go to <color=#orange>Demonbind Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place with a crimson maple forest and unrelenting clamor of killing...
TaskDescription_42.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“囚魔木”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处枫林殷红，杀伐不绝，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_43.en: Go to <color=#orange>Rainbow Ultima Sword Mound</color>, unseal the Mound, and fight the enemy. Danger looms over this place covered in lights of varying hues and where the sun and moon appear side by side...
TaskDescription_43.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「剑冢“鬼神霞”」</color>，解封剑冢并迎战敌人。此处霞光万丈，日月同天，凶险异常……

TaskDescription_44.en: The first Sword Mound has been destroyed. You may return to the tile <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color>.
TaskDescription_44.cn: 已击破第一个剑冢，可回到地格<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>。

TaskDescription_45.en: When a Secret Tome appears in a region, there will be a <color=#orange>Secret Tome Encounter</color> in the region. People from all walks of life will contest for it. You will obtain the Secret Tome and be the first one to lay hands on it once you've defeated all the competitors. You'll also have a chance of getting the Secret Tome from the one who owns it through <color=#orange>Secret Tome Interaction</color>.
TaskDescription_45.cn: 奇书宝典出世时会在区域内产生<color=#orange>「奇书奇遇」</color>，各方人士将前往争夺，击败众人即能夺得奇书，亦可占尽先机，快人一步取得奇书；与奇书持有者进行<color=#orange>「奇书互动」</color>仍有一定机会从其手中得到奇书。

TaskDescription_46.en: Click <color=#orange>Secret Tome</color> to go to the page. For Secret Tomes related to Martial Arts, you can activate Bonus Stats with <color=#orange>XP</color> and unlock Special Slots where you can place certain weapons or Martial Arts for special bonuses. You'll unlock the Breakthrough Save Slot for this type of Martial Art after defeating the inner demon in the Secret Tome.
TaskDescription_46.cn: 点击<color=#orange>「奇书宝典」</color>进入界面。获取功法对应奇书时，可消耗<color=#orange>「历练」</color>开启对应属性加成，并开放可以放置特定兵器或功法的特效格，以获得特殊增强；击败奇书中的心魔可解锁此类功法的突破结果保存栏位。

TaskDescription_47.en: The second Sword Mound has been destroyed. You may return to the tile <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color>.
TaskDescription_47.cn: 已击破第二个剑冢，可回到地格<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>。

TaskDescription_62.en: The <color=#orange>Tea-Horse Caravan</color> can be built in Taiwu Village Industry - Construction Space by using Map of the West. Go to the Tea-Horse Caravan page, select provisions, and click <color=#orange>Depart</color>, and the caravan will head west when the months change. You can click <color=#orange>Return</color> to recall them after they have acquired exotic treasures from the Western Regions, or wait for them to return after they have exchanged all the provisions. The Tea-Horse Caravan consumes certain provisions every period and can pause its journey to gather provisions. Pay close attention to their provisions; otherwise, the provisions might be lost.
TaskDescription_62.cn: 进入「太吾村」产业并点击建设空间，使用「西域地图」建造建筑<color=#orange>「茶马帮」</color>。进入「茶马帮」界面，携带货物后点击<color=#orange>「出发」</color>，茶马帮即在过月时向西进发。自西域换得奇珍异宝后，可点击<color=#orange>「返程」</color>，或待其交换完毕所有货物后自行返回太吾村。茶马帮行进每时节都会消耗补给，中途可停留在原地搜集补给，需留意补给状况以防丢失货物。

TaskDescription_63.en: Gift <color=#orange>the Strange One</color> with <color=#orange>Western Regions Treasures</color> to increase Favorability.
TaskDescription_63.cn: 向<color=#orange>「奇异之人」</color>赠予<color=#orange>「西域珍宝」</color>以提升其好感度。

TaskDescription_64.en: Wait for the heroes to gather for the Martial World Tournament; this event concerns the fate of the Martial World, and you must attend.
TaskDescription_64.cn: 静候群雄集结天下武林盟会时机，此事关乎武林命运，务必前往参加。

TaskDescription_65.en: While the <color=#orange>Martial World Tournament</color> is being prepared, you may influence each sect's Preparation by donating resources to their respective warehouses. When the preparation period concludes, the sect with the highest Preparation will host the <color=#orange>Martial World Tournament</color>. The fate of Martial World is riding on this. Please do participate...
TaskDescription_65.cn: <color=#orange>「天下武林盟会」</color>筹备过程中可通过向各门派库房中捐赠资源影响各门派的筹备力量。筹备期满后将由筹备力量最高的门派举行<color=#orange>「天下武林盟会」</color>。此事关乎武林命运，务必前往参加……

TaskDescription_66.en: The <color=#orange>Martial World Tournament</color> will affect the fate of Martial World. Please do participate in it when it starts.
TaskDescription_66.cn: <color=#orange>「天下武林盟会」</color>关乎武林命运，举办时务必前往参加。

TaskDescription_645.cn: 魔血暗涌，似为指引，前往任一州域的<color=#orange>主城</color>一探究竟。

TaskDescription_646.en: Go to a <color=#orange>Settlement</color> other than Taiwu Village, enter the Industry View, click on the <color=#orange>[Warehouse]</color> building, and select <color=#orange>items</color> to loot.
TaskDescription_646.cn: 前往太吾村以外的<color=#orange>定居点</color>，进入产业界面，点击建筑<color=#orange>「库房」</color>，选择<color=#orange>物品</color>进行掠夺。

TaskDescription_647.en: Interact with a <color=#orange>character</color> and find an excuse to <color=#orange>attack</color>.

TaskDescription_648.en: Stay on the same tile during month advance with an <color=#orange>adult character</color> whose Favorability is no less than Intimate, who is not a relative and not a spouse, and spend <color=#orange>a night together</color>.
TaskDescription_648.cn: 与好感不低于亲密、不为亲属、不为配偶的<color=#orange>成年人物</color>同地格过月，并且与之<color=#orange>共度春宵</color>。

TaskDescription_649.en: Dark flames surge incessantly, as if guiding you. Go to the Encounter <color=#orange>[Demonic Blood Blackstone]</color> at <color=#orange>{0}</color> to investigate.
TaskDescription_649.cn: 黑焰翻涌不息，似为指引，前往位于<color=#orange>{0}</color>的奇遇<color=#orange>「魔血玄石」</color>一探究竟。

TaskDescription_650.en: Demonic Blood stirs strangely, as if guiding you. Head to the <color=#orange>Main City</color> in any province to investigate.
TaskDescription_650.cn: 魔血异动，似为指引，前往任一州域的<color=#orange>主城</color>一探究竟。

TaskDescription_651.en: The <color=#orange>[Bamboo Incarnation]</color> has manifested an unusual state. Perhaps its secrets can be uncovered via a deep conversation...
TaskDescription_651.cn: <color=#orange>「紫竹化身」</color>现出非常之状，或可与之深谈，探明其中关窍……

TaskDescription_652.en: Recently, Dayue Yaochang manifested from the Bamboo seems to be seeking opponents for a bout. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to speak with him.
TaskDescription_652.cn: 近日紫竹所化的大岳瑶常似乎在寻人比斗，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月与之一谈。

TaskDescription_653.en: Dayue Yaochang manifested from the Bamboo is awaiting the Successor of Taiwu for a battle. You may seek him out when free.
TaskDescription_653.cn: 紫竹所化的大岳瑶常正在等待太吾传人与之一战，待得空时可主动去寻之。

TaskDescription_654.en: During the bout, Dayue Yaochang's giant sword unexpectedly cracked, and faint spiritual light is leaking in the fissure. Repairing this sword for him may reveal its hidden secrets.
TaskDescription_654.cn: 紫竹所化的大岳瑶常的巨剑在比斗中意外崩裂，裂隙之中显出隐隐灵光，助其修好此剑兴许能探明剑中隐秘。

TaskDescription_655.en: Recently, Wei Qi manifested from the Bamboo has been pondering all day. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to ask the reason.
TaskDescription_655.cn: 近日紫竹所化的卫起终日沉思，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月询问缘由。

TaskDescription_656.en: Wei Qi manifested from the Bamboo has been meditating for months without a word. Perhaps you should go and find out why.
TaskDescription_656.cn: 紫竹所化的卫起累月冥思，一言不发，兴许应去一问究竟。

TaskDescription_657.en: <color=#orange>Since the onset of winter</color>, Jiu Han manifested from the Bamboo has been passionately carving snow statues; perhaps you should go and observe.
TaskDescription_657.cn: <color=#orange>在冬季月份</color>，紫竹所化的九寒始终忘情地雕塑雪像，或可前去一观。

TaskDescription_658.en: <color=#orange>Every winter</color>, Jiu Han manifested from the Bamboo becomes engrossed in carving snow sculptures; perhaps you should go and investigate.
TaskDescription_658.cn: <color=#orange>每年冬季</color>，紫竹所化的九寒便只沉湎于雕琢雪塑，或可前去一探究竟。

TaskDescription_659.en: Recently, Blood Maple manifested from the Bamboo seems to be gathering things. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to speak with him.
TaskDescription_659.cn: 近日紫竹所化的血枫似乎正在召集事物，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月与之一谈。

TaskDescription_660.en: Blood Maple manifested from the Bamboo still invites the Successor of Taiwu to come and inspect the Ironclad Army. You may seek him out when free.
TaskDescription_660.cn: 紫竹所化的血枫仍旧邀请太吾传人前去一道检阅铁军，待得空时可主动去寻之。

TaskDescription_661.en: Strange flames flicker, peach blossoms fall. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to meet the White Fox and witness this beautiful mirage.
TaskDescription_661.cn: 异火飘摇，桃花纷落，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月路遇白狐，见此蜃景。

TaskDescription_662.en: Yi Yihou manifested from the Bamboo seems to be weeping mournfully. Perhaps you should uncover the reason...
TaskDescription_662.cn: 紫竹所化的衣以候似在哀声涕泣，或可前去问询，探明缘由……

TaskDescription_663.en: Yi Xiang, transformed from Purple Bamboo, sits motionless in a daze, gazing blankly into the distance. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until next month and ask about the reason.
TaskDescription_663.cn: 紫竹所化的以向木然呆坐，兀自痴望，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月询问缘由

TaskDescription_664.en: Yi Xiang, transformed from Purple Bamboo, sits frozen in place without moving. Perhaps it would be best to ask what happened...
TaskDescription_664.cn: 紫竹所化的以向木然呆坐，凝然不动，或可前去问清因由……

TaskDescription_665.en: Recently, Jin Huang'er manifested from the Bamboo seems to have found a jug of fine wine. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to drink with her...
TaskDescription_665.cn: 近日紫竹所化的金凰儿似寻得一壶美酒，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月与之共饮……

TaskDescription_666.en: Jin Huang'er manifested from the Bamboo has found fine wine and wishes to share it with others. Perhaps you should go and taste it together...
TaskDescription_666.cn: 紫竹所化的金凰儿寻得美酒，欲与人同享，或可前去一同品酌……

TaskDescription_667.en: Soon torrential rain will pour down, as if an enchanting dream invites one to sleep. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to enter this dream...
TaskDescription_667.cn: 不日将有暴雨倾落，似有绮梦邀人入眠，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月入此梦境……

TaskDescription_668.en: Spellwright manifested from the Bamboo excels in the Rainbow-Laying Art; now she seems to be forming an array in the rain. Perhaps you should go and investigate...
TaskDescription_668.cn: 紫竹所化的术方擅布虹之术，此刻似在雨中结阵，或可前去一探究竟……

TaskDescription_669.en: Monu manifested from the Bamboo has a karmic bond with birds. <color=#orange>Wait</color> until the next month to encounter the spirit bird and uncover the reason...
TaskDescription_669.cn: 紫竹所化的莫女与鸟儿结有宿缘，<color=#orange>静待</color>来月路遇灵鸟，探明因由……

TaskDescription_670.en: Monu manifested from the Bamboo plays the guqin alone. The music is distant and faint, the melody lonely and sad. Perhaps you should go and ask why...
TaskDescription_670.cn: 紫竹所化的莫女独自抚琴，乐音幽邈，曲调寂寥，或可前去问清缘由……

TaskDescription_677.en: There is a group of refugees nearby. You might pay them a visit and learn some information.
TaskDescription_677.cn: 附近正有一队流民，不妨前往探听消息。
TaskDescription_677.ru: Неподалеку находится группа беженцев. Вы могли бы нанести им визит и узнать кое-какую информацию.

TaskDescription_678.en: The <color=#orange>refugees</color> look worried, as if they are in some trouble. You might try to learn something from them.
TaskDescription_678.cn: <color=#orange>流民</color>面露忧色，似是有何难处，不妨前往探听一二。

TaskDescription_679.en: Go to the edge of the map and enter the Major Event <color=#orange>[Seeking Food]</color>.
TaskDescription_679.cn: 前往地图边缘，进入大事件<color=#orange>「寻找食物」</color>。
TaskDescription_679.ru: Подойдите к краю карты и примите участие в главном событии <color=#orange>[В поисках Еды]</color>.

TaskDescription_680.en: Doctor Ning looks worried, as if there is some difficulty in treating the injured. You might as well <color=#orange>go to "Taiwu Village"</color> to find out more.
TaskDescription_680.cn: 宁大夫面露忧色，似是治疗伤者之事有何难处，不妨<color=#orange>前往“太吾村”</color>探听一二。

TaskDescription_681.en: Go to the edge of the map and enter the Major Event <color=#orange>[Seeking Herbs]</color>.
TaskDescription_681.cn: 前往地图边缘，进入大事件<color=#orange>「寻找药材」</color>。
TaskDescription_681.ru: Подойдите к краю карты и примите участие в главном событии <color=#orange>[Ищу Травы]</color>.

TaskDescription_682.en: <color=#orange>Madam Ning</color> looks worried, as if she is in some trouble. You might pay her a visit to figure out why.
TaskDescription_682.cn: <color=#orange>宁夫人</color>面露忧色，似是有何难处，不妨前往探听一二。

TaskDescription_683.en: Go to the edge of the map and enter the Major Event <color=#orange>[Seeking Clothing]</color>.
TaskDescription_683.cn: 前往地图边缘，进入大事件<color=#orange>「寻找衣物」</color>。
TaskDescription_683.ru: Подойдите к краю карты и примите участие в главном событии <color=#orange>[Ищет одежду]</color>.

TaskDescription_684.en: I wonder if the <color=#orange>unnamed wounded</color> has recovered. Go pay him a visit.
TaskDescription_684.cn: 不知<color=#orange>无名伤者</color>可有好转，且前去探望一番。
TaskDescription_684.ru: Интересно, если бы <color=#orange>неназванный раненый</color> выздоровел. Пойди нанеси ему визит.

TaskDescription_685.en: After arriving at <color=#orange>Ling Island</color>, take Immortal Xu's reed on the <color=#orange>World Map</color> to find and go to <color=#orange>Mt. Chai</color>, find Tainted, and ask about the method to save Huanxin.
TaskDescription_685.cn: 抵达<color=#orange>灵山岛</color>之后，可持徐仙公的芦苇于<color=#orange>世界地图</color>寻找并前往<color=#orange>柴山</color>，寻得染尘子，问询相救焕心之法。

TaskDescription_686.en: Go to the Encounter <color=#orange>[Gods and Demons' Thought]</color> to assist Tainted and Foster Father.
TaskDescription_686.cn: 前往奇遇<color=#orange>「神魔一念」</color>，相助染尘子与义父。

TaskDescription_700.en: Head to each province to defeat the <color=#orange>Twelve Evil Immortals</color>. If you follow your companion's advice and allow them to assassinate the Evil Immortals, then wait for news of their victory.
TaskDescription_700.cn: 前往各州域降伏<color=#orange>十二邪仙</color>，若依从同伴所言，准许其袭杀邪仙，则静待其传来捷报。

TaskDescription_687.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Bashu</color> to defeat Chi Hongzi, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_687.cn: 前往<color=#orange>巴蜀</color>，降伏十二邪仙之赤鸿子。
TaskDescription_687.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Башу</color> чтобы победить Чи Хунцзы, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_688.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Jiangnan</color> to defeat Jiu Yan, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_688.cn: 前往<color=#orange>江南</color>，降伏十二邪仙之九嫣。
TaskDescription_688.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Цзяннань</color> чтобы победить Цзю Яня, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_689.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Liaodong</color> to defeat Lady Ye Hua, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_689.cn: 前往<color=#orange>辽东</color>，降伏十二邪仙之夜华夫人。
TaskDescription_689.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Ляодун</color> чтобы победить госпожу Е Хуа, одну из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_690.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Jingnan</color> to defeat Lady Wuxie, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_690.cn: 前往<color=#orange>荆南</color>，降伏十二邪仙之无邪娘子。
TaskDescription_690.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Цзиннань</color> чтобы победить леди Уси, одну из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_691.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Yunnan</color> to defeat Su Xia, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_691.cn: 前往<color=#orange>云南</color>，降伏十二邪仙之素瑕。
TaskDescription_691.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Юньнань</color> чтобы победить Су Ся, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_692.en: Proceed to the <color=#orange>Western Regions</color> to defeat Po Jin Shangren, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_692.cn: 前往<color=#orange>西域</color>，降伏十二邪仙之破烬上人。

TaskDescription_693.en: Proceed to the <color=#orange>Jingji</color> to defeat Wu Fangke, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_693.cn: 前往<color=#orange>京畿</color>，降伏十二邪仙之无方客。
TaskDescription_693.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Цзинцзи</color> чтобы победить Ву Фанке, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_694.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Huainan</color> to defeat Dian Fan Mo, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_694.cn: 前往<color=#orange>淮南</color>，降伏十二邪仙之颠反魔。
TaskDescription_694.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Хуайнань</color> чтобы победить Диан Фан Мо, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_695.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Guangnan</color> to defeat Huo Gushi, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_695.cn: 前往<color=#orange>广南</color>，降伏十二邪仙之活骨师。
TaskDescription_695.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Гуаннань</color> чтобы победить Хо Гуши, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_696.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Shandong</color> to defeat Ba Jiu Jian Yin, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_696.cn: 前往<color=#orange>山东</color>，降伏十二邪仙之八九剑隐。

TaskDescription_697.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Guangdong</color> to defeat True Pill Divine Maiden, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_697.cn: 前往<color=#orange>广东</color>，降伏十二邪仙之真丹圣女。

TaskDescription_698.en: Proceed to <color=#orange>Jiangbei</color> to defeat You Xiao, one of the Twelve Evil Immortals.
TaskDescription_698.cn: 前往<color=#orange>江北</color>，降伏十二邪仙之幽宵。
TaskDescription_698.ru: Переходите к <color=#orange>Цзянбэй</color> чтобы победить Ю Сяо, одного из двенадцати Злых Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_732.en: The surroundings have turned into <color=#orange>Blackstone Land</color>. Get away as soon as possible to avoid its harm...
TaskDescription_732.cn: 周遭皆化作<color=#orange>玄石之地</color>，尽快远离，免受其害……

TaskDescription_730.en: Evil spirits not yet exterminated, await Opportunity.
TaskDescription_730.cn: 妖邪尚未尽除，静待机缘。
TaskDescription_730.ru: Злые духи, которые еще не истреблены, ждут удобного случая.

TaskDescription_701.en: The whereabouts of Zi Wuxiao is now clear. Go to the Major Event <color=#orange>[Wuxiao under Moonlight]</color> located at <color=#orange>{0}</color> to investigate.
TaskDescription_701.cn: 紫无绡去向已明，且前往位于<color=#orange>{0}</color>的大事件<color=#orange>「月浣无绡」</color>一探究竟。

TaskDescription_702.en: At midnight, an anomaly suddenly occurred. Go to the Major Event <color=#orange>[Immortal's Letter]</color> located at <color=#orange>{0}</color> to investigate.
TaskDescription_702.cn: 夜半子时，异变突生，且前往位于<color=#orange>{0}</color>的大事件<color=#orange>「仙公遗信」</color>一探究竟。

TaskDescription_703.en: Following Huanxin's guidance, seek the traces of the Immortal. Go to the Major Event <color=#orange>[Boat on the Sea]</color> located at <color=#orange>{0}</color>.
TaskDescription_703.cn: 循焕心指引，觅仙公踪迹。前往位于<color=#orange>{0}</color>的大事件<color=#orange>「孽海浮舟」</color>。

TaskDescription_704.en: Head to <color=#orange>Mt. Chai</color> and enter the Major Event <color=#orange>[Gods and Demons' Clash]</color>.
TaskDescription_704.cn: 前往<color=#orange>柴山</color>，进入大事件<color=#orange>「决战神魔」</color>。

TaskDescription_85.en: Visit the temples in the <color=#orange>villages, stockaded villages, cities, and towns</color> of each province. Most temples are in the <color=#orange>Main Cities</color> while some may also be found in <color=#orange>other regions</color>.
TaskDescription_85.cn: 前往天下州域各个地区下辖<color=#orange>村，寨，城，镇</color>参拜寺庙。寺庙大多位于该州域的<color=#orange>主城所在地区</color>，亦有部分寺庙零星散落于<color=#orange>其他地区</color>。

TaskDescription_96.en: Visit the temples in the <color=#orange>Western Regions</color>.

TaskDescription_101.en: Accept the <color=#orange>Kongsang Sect Leader's</color> request and test the poison for Liao Wuming.
TaskDescription_101.cn: 接受<color=#orange>空桑派掌门</color>的请求，帮助廖无命试毒。

TaskDescription_102.en: Talk to <color=#orange>Liao Wuming</color> and <color=#orange>wait until</color> he's found a subject for the poison test.
TaskDescription_102.cn: 与<color=#orange>廖无命</color>对话，随后<color=#orange>静待</color>其寻得试毒人选，再前去相助。

TaskDescription_103.en: Liao Wuming sent a letter, saying that he had found a subject in <color=#orange>{0}</color>. You may go help him.
TaskDescription_103.cn: 廖无命遣人来信，已在<color=#orange>{0}</color>寻得试毒人选，可前往相助。

TaskDescription_104.en: Return to the <color=#orange>Kongsang Sect to visit the sect leader</color> and explain about the poison test.
TaskDescription_104.cn: 回到<color=#orange>空桑派拜访掌门</color>，说明试毒一事。

TaskDescription_105.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for Liao Wuming to find a subject for the poison test.
TaskDescription_105.ru: <color=#orange>Ждать</color> чтобы Ляо Умин нашел объект для теста на Яд.

TaskDescription_106.en: Liao Wuming sent a letter, saying that he had found a subject in <color=#orange>{0}</color>. You may go help him.
TaskDescription_106.cn: 廖无命遣人来信，已在<color=#orange>{0}</color>寻得试毒人选，可前往相助。

TaskDescription_107.en: Return to the <color=#orange>Kongsang Sect</color> to <color=#orange>visit the sect leader</color> and elaborate on the poison test.
TaskDescription_107.cn: 回到<color=#orange>空桑派</color>，<color=#orange>拜访掌门</color>，详述试毒一事。

TaskDescription_108.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for Liao Wuming to find a subject for the poison test.
TaskDescription_108.ru: <color=#orange>Ждать</color> чтобы Ляо Умин нашел объект для теста на Яд.

TaskDescription_109.en: Liao Wuming sent a letter, saying that he had found a subject in <color=#orange>{0}</color>. You may go help him.
TaskDescription_109.cn: 廖无命遣人来信，已在<color=#orange>{0}</color>寻得试毒人选，可前往相助。

TaskDescription_110.en: Return to the <color=#orange>Kongsang Sect</color> to <color=#orange>visit the sect leader</color> and recount the experience with the poison test.
TaskDescription_110.cn: 回到<color=#orange>空桑派</color>，<color=#orange>拜访掌门</color>，讲述试毒经历。

TaskDescription_111.en: Ask <color=#orange>Liao Wuming</color> about the deadly poison.
TaskDescription_111.cn: 与<color=#orange>廖无命</color>对话，询问奇毒之事。

TaskDescription_112.en: The deadly poison has been crafted. Return to the <color=#orange>Kongsang Sect</color> to <color=#orange>visit the sect leader</color> and report the poison test.
TaskDescription_112.cn: 奇毒已成，回到<color=#orange>空桑派</color>，<color=#orange>拜访掌门</color>，复命试毒一事。

TaskDescription_113.en: [For one who has sought longevity but failed, the world lasts but an instant.] Liao Wuming has left for an unknown fate. Will we ever meet again?
TaskDescription_113.cn: 「长生无得者，举世如蜉蝣。」廖无命一去，存亡未卜，不知往后可还有缘相见？

TaskDescription_114.en: Go to <color=#orange>Mt. Kongsang</color> and initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Haze of Mt. Kongsang</color>.
TaskDescription_114.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「空桑山」</color>，进入奇遇<color=#orange>「长生之死」</color>。

TaskDescription_115.en: Travel to the nearby area of the <color=#orange>Sanguine Sect</color> and interact with any <color=#orange>Sanguine Disciples' graves</color> to initiate <color=#orange>Tomb Raiding</color> and investigate the ghosts.
TaskDescription_115.cn: 前往<color=#orange>血犼教</color>附近，与任意<color=#orange>血犼弟子的坟墓</color>互动，进行<color=#orange>「摸金倒斗」</color>，以探查鬼怪之事。

TaskDescription_116.en: The connection between the <color=#orange>Rusted Bell</color> and the Sanguine Valley runs deep. Investigate here and proceed with caution.
TaskDescription_116.cn: <color=#orange>破旧的铃铛</color>与血犼谷关联颇深，留在此处探查并谨慎行事。

TaskDescription_117.en: The thing about the Red-Robed Senior is very weird indeed. Investigate the matter carefully in the <color=#orange>Sanguine Valley</color>.
TaskDescription_117.cn: 红衣老人一事颇为妖异，留在<color=#orange>血犼谷</color>谨慎探查。

TaskDescription_118.en: The <color=#orange>Red-Robed Senior</color> has appeared. Talk to him with caution.
TaskDescription_118.cn: <color=#orange>红衣老人</color>现身，与其谨慎交谈。
TaskDescription_118.ru: Тот <color=#orange>Старший в красном одеянии</color> появился. Разговаривайте с ним осторожно.

TaskDescription_119.en: Stay at the <color=#orange>Bloodgleam</color> until the <color=#orange>Red-Robed Senior</color> comes.
TaskDescription_119.cn: 在<color=#orange>血光</color>处停留，等待<color=#orange>红衣老人</color>前来。

TaskDescription_121.en: Take Jixi back to the <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color>. It seems that there is some hidden connection between you and Jixi. If, by any chance, you <color=#orange>passed down the hilt</color> to her, the consequence might be irrevocable.
TaskDescription_121.cn: 携姬穸回到<color=#orange>太吾村</color>。此身似与姬穸颇有渊源，若是此后不慎<color=#orange>传剑</color>，可能造成无法挽回的后果。

TaskDescription_122.en: Stay in the <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color> with Jixi.

TaskDescription_123.en: Go to <color=#orange>Eerie Mystery</color> and investigate the strange incident in the village when the Encounter occurs. Otherwise, stay in the Taiwu Village with Jixi.
TaskDescription_123.cn: 奇遇存在时，前往<color=#orange>诡事悬谜</color>，调查村中异事，其余时日留在太吾村陪伴姬穸。

TaskDescription_124.en: Where did the evil beings in the Taiwu Village come from?
TaskDescription_124.cn: 太吾村中，何时有此妖邪……
TaskDescription_124.ru: Откуда взялись злые существа в Деревне Тайу?

TaskDescription_125.en: A ghost is eating humans. Could it really be Jixi...?
TaskDescription_125.cn: 妖鬼吃人，莫非真是姬穸……
TaskDescription_125.ru: Призрак ест людей. Неужели это действительно Джикси?..

TaskDescription_126.en: The Ghost Lady led me here... but why...?
TaskDescription_126.cn: 女鬼引我来此，究竟何意……
TaskDescription_126.ru: Леди-призрак привела меня сюда... но почему...?

TaskDescription_127.en: Is the ghost lady at night really Jixi?
TaskDescription_127.cn: 夜半女鬼，莫非当真是姬穸……

TaskDescription_128.cn: 这衣料原为红色，似曾相识……

TaskDescription_129.en: Could it be... that Jixi really kills people?
TaskDescription_129.ru: Может ли быть... что Джикси действительно убивает людей?

TaskDescription_130.en: There will be an answer to the strange incidents in the village. Wait for some time, and the truth will be revealed...
TaskDescription_130.cn: 村中异事，终有一解。静待些许时日，当有分说……

TaskDescription_131.en: Search for Jixi in <color=#orange>{0}</color> and talk to her.
TaskDescription_131.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>寻找姬穸，并与其交谈。
TaskDescription_131.ru: Ищите Jixi в <color=#orange>{0}</color> и поговори с ней.

TaskDescription_132.en: <color=#orange>Interact</color> with the people of <color=#orange>Shaolin Sect</color> and ask them about the collapse of the Pagoda Forest.
TaskDescription_132.cn: 与<color=#orange>少林派</color>众人<color=#orange>互动</color>，询问塔林崩塌一事。

TaskDescription_133.en: The monk has asked me to <color=#orange>return the Filthy Statuette to the Shaolin Sect</color>, but I should keep it for now and <color=#orange>bide my time</color> because the collapse of the Pagoda Forest seems to suggest some unusual <color=#orange>fate</color>.
TaskDescription_133.cn: 小僧虽有所托，将肮脏的雕像<color=#orange>归还少林派</color>；然而塔林倾塌非同寻常，持此物或有<color=#orange>机缘</color>，不妨暂且收存，<color=#orange>静待</color>良机。

TaskDescription_134.en: <color=#orange>Interact</color> with the Shaolin Sect's members and return the <color=#orange>Filthy Statuette</color> to them.
TaskDescription_134.cn: 与少林派人物<color=#orange>互动</color>，将<color=#orange>肮脏的雕像</color>归还少林派。

TaskDescription_135.en: <color=#orange>Stay at the Shaolin Sect</color> and wait for enlightenment.
TaskDescription_135.ru: <color=#orange>Остановитесь в Секте Шаолинь</color> и ждите просветления.

TaskDescription_136.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for the Old Monk's dream-borne enlightenment.\nWith the statuette, you may still meet the Old Monk in dreams even if you do not stay in the Shaolin Sect.
TaskDescription_136.cn: <color=#orange>等待</color>老僧梦中机缘。\n只要持有雕像，即使不留在少林派，也可入梦与老僧相会。

TaskDescription_137.en: <color=#orange>Interact</color> with the Shaolin Sect's members and return the <color=#orange>Broken Statuette</color> to the sect.
TaskDescription_137.cn: 与少林派人物<color=#orange>互动</color>，将<color=#orange>破碎的雕像</color>归还少林派。

TaskDescription_139.en: Complete the breakthrough of Shaolin Martial Art <color=#orange>{0}</color> taught by the Old Monk.
TaskDescription_139.cn: 将老僧传授的少林功法<color=#orange>{0}</color>完成突破。
TaskDescription_139.ru: Завершите Прорыв в Боевой технике Шаолинь <color=#orange>{0}</color> учил старый Монах.

TaskDescription_140.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> patiently for the Old Monk to return.\nWith the statuette, you may still meet the Old Monk in dreams even if you do not stay in the Shaolin Sect.
TaskDescription_140.cn: 静心<color=#orange>等待</color>梦中老僧再临。\n只要持有雕像，即使不留在少林派，也可入梦与老僧相会。

TaskDescription_141.en: <color=#orange>Excavate</color> at the Shaolin Sect for the treasure that the Old Monk mentioned.
TaskDescription_141.cn: 在少林派中<color=#orange>挖掘寻索</color>老僧所说秘宝。
TaskDescription_141.ru: <color=#orange>Выкапывать</color> в Секте Шаолинь в поисках сокровища, о котором упоминал Старый Монах.

TaskDescription_142.en: Practice with all your heart. <color=#orange>Wait for {0} month(s)</color> to fight the old monk in the dream again.\nWith the statuette, you may still meet the Old Monk in dreams even if you do not stay in the Shaolin Sect.
TaskDescription_142.cn: 勤学苦修，<color=#orange>等待{0}个月</color>老僧入梦再战。\n只要持有雕像，即使不留在少林派，也可入梦与老僧相会。

TaskDescription_143.en: Having obtained the sacred Buddhist sutra, <color=#orange>wait</color> for the enlightenment of the old monk in the dream.\nWith the statuette, you may still meet him in dreams even if you do not stay in the Shaolin Sect.
TaskDescription_143.cn: 已得佛法经典，<color=#orange>等待</color>老僧入梦机缘。\n只要持有雕像，即使不留在少林派，也可入梦与老僧相会。

TaskDescription_144.en: Read <color=#orange>{0}</color> and study <color=#orange>at least three chapters</color>. If you have finished studying it, <color=#orange>wait</color> for the Old Monk in your dream for enlightenment.
TaskDescription_144.cn: 研读书籍，将<color=#orange>{0}</color>研读<color=#orange>至少三篇</color>；若已研读完毕，则可<color=#orange>静待</color>老僧梦中机缘。

TaskDescription_145.en: Head to Shaolin Sect Industry, and click Building <color=#orange>Shaolin Sect</color> to observe the Pagoda Forest.
TaskDescription_145.cn: 前往少林派产业，点击建筑<color=#orange>少林派</color>观察塔林。

TaskDescription_146.en: Head to Shaolin Sect Industry, and click the building <color=#orange>Sutra Pavilion</color> to search for secret treasures.
TaskDescription_146.cn: 前往少林派产业，点击建筑<color=#orange>藏经阁</color>搜寻秘宝。

TaskDescription_147.en: The riddle of this melody remains unsolved. Perhaps <color=#orange>waiting</color> will bring clarity.
TaskDescription_147.cn: 琴情之惑难解，不如<color=#orange>静待</color>时机，或有分晓。

TaskDescription_148.en: <color=#orange>Await</color> the arrival of a letter sealed with the emblem of Azure Luan.
TaskDescription_148.cn: <color=#orange>等待</color>盖有青鸾之印的神秘来信。
TaskDescription_148.ru: <color=#orange>Ждать</color> прибытие письма, запечатанного эмблемой Лазурного Луана.

TaskDescription_149.en: Head to the <color=#orange>towns and villages of Jade-Maiden Peak</color> and inquire about the Mysterious One by speaking to <color=#orange>local residents</color>.
TaskDescription_149.cn: 前往<color=#orange>璇女峰城镇村寨</color>，与<color=#orange>当地居民</color>互动，打听神秘人之事。

TaskDescription_150.en: Search for <color=#orange>Yun'er</color> again to learn what has transpired.
TaskDescription_150.cn: 再次<color=#orange>寻找筠儿</color>，探知后续之事。

TaskDescription_151.en: Go to the Encounter: <color=#orange>The Solitary Crane</color>. You may also interact with <color=#orange>Jade-Maiden Sect members</color> to inquire about the Mysterious One and Solitary Crane and Mirrored Water (Music Box).
TaskDescription_151.cn: 前往奇遇<color=#orange>「镜里孤鸾」</color>。亦可与<color=#orange>璇女派人物</color>互动，打听神秘人与《孤鸾镜水谣》之事。

TaskDescription_152.en: If you change your mind, head to Jade-Maiden Sect's Industry and click the building <color=#orange>Egarim</color> to search for <color=#orange>Yun'er</color>.
TaskDescription_152.cn: 若改换心意，可前往璇女派产业，点击建筑<color=#orange>一明珏</color>，<color=#orange>寻找筠儿</color>。

TaskDescription_153.en: After completing the breakthrough of the Jade-Maiden Sect martial art <color=#orange>{0}</color> taught by Yun'er, head to Egarim and <color=#orange>search for Yun'er for further In-Mirror Cultivation</color>.
TaskDescription_153.cn: 将筠儿传授的璇女功法<color=#orange>{0}</color>完成突破后，前往一明珏<color=#orange>寻找筠儿入镜修习</color>。

TaskDescription_154.en: Return to Jade-Maiden Peak and <color=#orange>seek Yun'er</color> in Egarim.
TaskDescription_154.cn: 返回璇女峰，去一明珏中<color=#orange>寻找筠儿</color>。
TaskDescription_154.ru: Возвращайтесь к Нефриту-Девичьему пику и <color=#orange>ищи Юн'эра</color> в Эгариме.

TaskDescription_155.en: Bring Shi Weizhi back to Jade-Maiden Peak and <color=#orange>seek Yun'er</color> in Egarim.
TaskDescription_155.cn: 携石薇芝速速返回璇女峰，去一明珏中<color=#orange>寻找筠儿</color>。
TaskDescription_155.ru: Верни Ши Вэйчжи на Нефрит-Девичий пик и <color=#orange>ищи Юн'эра</color> в Эгариме.

TaskDescription_156.en: Search for <color=#orange>Yun'er</color> again to learn what has transpired.
TaskDescription_156.cn: 再次<color=#orange>寻找筠儿</color>，探知后续之事。

TaskDescription_157.en: Return to <color=#orange>Jade-Maiden Peak</color> and inquire about the senior sister's whereabouts.
TaskDescription_157.cn: 返回<color=#orange>璇女峰</color>，再询师姐去向。
TaskDescription_157.ru: Вернуться к <color=#orange>Нефрит-Девичий пик</color> и расспросите о местонахождении старшей сестры.

TaskDescription_159.en: Interact with Jade-Maiden Sect members and <color=#orange>discuss the word "Love."</color>
TaskDescription_159.cn: 与璇女派人物互动，<color=#orange>论及“情”字</color>。
TaskDescription_159.ru: Взаимодействуйте с членами Секты Девы Нефрита и <color=#orange>обсудите слово "Любовь".</color>

TaskDescription_160.en: Head to Egarim on Jade-Maiden Peak again to search for Yun'er and perform <color=#orange>In-Mirror Cultivation</color> to improve strength.
TaskDescription_160.cn: 提升实力，再次前往璇女峰一明珏中，寻找筠儿，<color=#orange>入镜修习</color>。

TaskDescription_161.en: Head to Egarim on Jade-Maiden Peak and search for Yun'er for <color=#orange>In-Mirror Cultivation</color>
TaskDescription_161.cn: 前往璇女峰一明珏中，寻找筠儿，<color=#orange>入镜修习</color>。

TaskDescription_162.en: Head to Jade-Maiden Sect's Industry and click the building <color=#orange>Egarim</color> to <color=#orange>search for Yun'er for In-Mirror Cultivation</color>.
TaskDescription_162.cn: 前往璇女派产业，点击建筑<color=#orange>一明珏</color>，<color=#orange>寻找筠儿入镜修习</color>。

TaskDescription_164.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> and search for the one who harbors the senior sister's spirit.
TaskDescription_164.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，寻找师姐魂灵依附之人。
TaskDescription_164.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>{0}</color> и ищите того, в ком живет Дух старшей сестры.

TaskDescription_166.en: Upon reaching a <color=#orange>sect, main city, or province (regions not devastated)</color>, the local tunes will be collected into the Music Box.\nSelect item <color=#orange>Music Box</color> from the travel bag and open it, and the <color=#orange>Music Piece Slot</color> will appear above [Notes] on the upper right of the main screen. Tap the Music Piece Slot to play collected tunes and replace the currently playing music.
TaskDescription_166.cn: 到达<color=#orange>门派、主城、州域（未毁坏地区）</color>时，当地的乐曲便会抄录至《孤鸾镜水谣》中。\n在行囊中选取物品<color=#orange>《孤鸾镜水谣》</color>并开启，主界面右上角「手记」上方会出现<color=#orange>乐谱栏</color>。点击乐谱栏，可播放已收录的乐曲，并替换当前的音乐。

TaskDescription_167.en: Perform a <color=#orange>Heterodox Breakthrough</color> on any Wudang Sect Martial Art, and perhaps the Taoist will appear.
TaskDescription_167.cn: 以<color=#orange>逆练参悟</color>任意武当派功法，或可引道人现身。

TaskDescription_168.en: The Unkempt Taoist is an enigma—might as well <color=#orange>wait and observe him patiently</color>.
TaskDescription_168.cn: 邋遢道长神秘莫测，不如<color=#orange>静心观察等待</color>。
TaskDescription_168.ru: Неопрятный даос — загадка, с таким же успехом он мог бы <color=#orange>ждите и терпеливо наблюдайте за ним</color>.

TaskDescription_169.en: Head to <color=#orange>Wudang Sect</color> and talk to the <color=#orange>Unkempt Taoist</color>.
TaskDescription_169.cn: 前往<color=#orange>武当派</color>，与<color=#orange>邋遢道长</color>对话。
TaskDescription_169.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Секта Удан</color> и поговори с <color=#orange>Неопрятный даос</color>.

TaskDescription_170.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> and explore the Celestial Realm.
TaskDescription_170.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>{0}</color> и исследуйте Небесное царство.

TaskDescription_171.en: Head to the Wudang Sect and deliver the relic to the <color=#orange>Unkempt Taoist</color>.
TaskDescription_171.cn: 前往武当派，与<color=#orange>邋遢道长</color>互动，交予灵宝。
TaskDescription_171.ru: Отправляйтесь в Секту Удан и доставьте Реликвию в <color=#orange>Неопрятный даос</color>.

TaskDescription_172.en: Select the <color=#orange>Sacred Wood Seed</color> from your Travel Bag to plant. To <color=#orange>nurture the Sacred Wood</color>, you can add resources, recite tomes, or destroy nearby underlings. Its growth requires 90000 resources, but this amount can be reduced by reciting tomes or destroying nearby underlings. Once the wood has grown, you can use it to <color=#orange>enter the celestial realm, obtain the spiritual treasure, and give it to Unkempt Taoist for the ritual.</color>
TaskDescription_172.cn: 在行囊中选取<color=#orange>通天神木种</color>进行种植，通过投入资源、诵读道藏、消灭附近爪牙等方式<color=#orange>养育通天神木</color>，神木长成需90000资源，通过诵读道藏或消灭附近爪牙等方式可减少资源投入。养育完成后，可经通天神木<color=#orange>进入洞天，取得灵宝，并交予邋遢道长</color>作法。

TaskDescription_173.en: Select the <color=#orange>Sacred Wood Seed</color> from your Travel Bag to plant. It cannot be planted near Sword Mound, Blackstone, or any settlement. You can plant multiple Sacred Woods at once, but they must not be too close to each other. While planting, any Outlaws within its range will be destroyed, and you will earn the Favor.
TaskDescription_173.cn: 在行囊中选取<color=#orange>通天神木种</color>进行种植。剑冢、玄石、定居点附近不可种植神木。可同时种植多棵神木，但神木之间不可相隔过近。种植神木时，若其位置或其范围内存在外道，外道将被清除，对应恩义由太吾获得。

TaskDescription_174.en: Interact with the Sacred Wood to enter the <color=#orange>Guard the Sacred Wood</color> interface. Each time a new month begins or the Sacred Wood enters a new phase, <color=#orange>Xiangshu Underlings</color> will appear near it. When a new month begins, Xiangshu Underlings will move one tile closer to the Sacred Wood along the indicated path. If they reach the tile where the wood stands, it will be destroyed. You can <color=#orange>dispatch villagers</color> along the path to stop them. Each villager can only stop one Xiangshu Underling on the same tile, and if successful, they will <color=#orange>lose some Health</color>.
TaskDescription_174.cn: 与通天神木互动，进入<color=#orange>守卫神木</color>界面。每次过月与神木成长至新阶段时，神木附近会出现若干<color=#orange>相枢爪牙</color>。过月时，相枢爪牙会沿着标示路径，向神木移动一格，抵达神木所在地格时，神木将会毁坏。在爪牙移动路径上<color=#orange>派遣村民</color>，可以阻挡爪牙前进。一名村民只能阻挡同地格的一个相枢爪牙，成功阻挡时会<color=#orange>减少村民健康值</color>。

TaskDescription_175.en: Study Taoism books to improve <color=#orange>Taoism Attainment</color> and unlock the Celestial Realm.
TaskDescription_175.cn: 研读道法书籍，提升<color=#orange>道法造诣</color>，以开启洞天。

TaskDescription_176.en: Visit Wudang Sect and interact with <color=#orange>Unkempt Taoist</color> to obtain the Sacred Wood Seed.
TaskDescription_176.cn: 前往武当派，与<color=#orange>邋遢道长</color>互动，换取通天神木之种。

TaskDescription_177.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for tidings from the Wudang Sect.

TaskDescription_178.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for tidings from the Unkempt Taoist.

TaskDescription_179.en: Head to the Wudang Sect and interact with the <color=#orange>Unkempt Taoist</color> to help him in his ritual.
TaskDescription_179.cn: 前往武当派，与<color=#orange>邋遢道长</color>互动，襄助其作法。

TaskDescription_180.en: The Sacred Wood has fully matured—<color=#orange>wait</color> for a chance to enter the Celestial Realm.
TaskDescription_180.cn: 神木已经长成，<color=#orange>等待</color>机缘以入洞天。

TaskDescription_181.en: With the matter of the Unkempt Taoist settled, interact with <color=#orange>the Wudang Sect's members</color> to learn their thoughts.
TaskDescription_181.cn: 邋遢道长之事已了，与<color=#orange>武当派人物</color>互动，询问武当派对此事的看法。

TaskDescription_182.en: Head to the <color=#orange>towns and villages</color> in Guangdong to seek out the anecdotes about the Lion-Face Clan.
TaskDescription_182.cn: 前往广东下辖各地区<color=#orange>城镇村寨</color>打听狮相门逸闻趣事。

TaskDescription_183.en: Rumors abound—Head to the <color=#orange>Lion-Face Clan</color> to investigate.
TaskDescription_183.cn: 传闻纷纷，前往<color=#orange>狮相门</color>一探究竟。
TaskDescription_183.ru: Слухов предостаточно — отправляйтесь в <color=#orange>Клан Львинолицых</color> чтобы провести расследование.

TaskDescription_184.en: <color=#orange>Head to the Lion-Face Clan</color> to meet its Leader and discuss the rumors about the Lion-Face Clan.
TaskDescription_184.cn: <color=#orange>前往狮相门</color>寻找门主商议狮相谣言之事。

TaskDescription_185.en: The disciples of the Lion-Face Clan act strangely—might as well <color=#orange>observe them quietly</color>.
TaskDescription_185.cn: 狮相门弟子举止并不寻常，不妨<color=#orange>静心观察</color>。

TaskDescription_186.en: Go to the Encounter: <color=#orange>Lion-Face Unique Arts</color>. If missed, the Encounter will arise again in <color=#orange>3 months</color>.
TaskDescription_186.cn: 前往奇遇<color=#orange>「狮相绝艺」</color>。若到期未能参加奇遇，需等待<color=#orange>3个月后</color>奇遇再次出现。

TaskDescription_187.en: Matters of the Lion-Face Clan seem to have reached a pause—might as well <color=#orange>wait for new tidings</color>. In the meantime, talking to <color=#orange>Scholars in Guangdong</color> may yield insights into the Lion-Face Clan.
TaskDescription_187.cn: 狮相门之事似乎已告一段落，不妨<color=#orange>静待消息</color>。或可趁闲暇之时与<color=#orange>广东州域的文人</color>交谈，探查狮相传闻始末。

TaskDescription_188.en: The Lion-Face Clan appears troubled, with Lotus Hill infested with Outlaws. Head to <color=#orange>Lotus Hill</color> to investigate the matter.
TaskDescription_188.cn: 狮相门似有变故，莲花山外道猖獗，前往<color=#orange>莲花山</color>地区探查一番。

TaskDescription_189.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Lion-Face Clan</color> to discuss the rising Outlaw threat.
TaskDescription_189.cn: 前往<color=#orange>狮相门</color>，商议外道之事。
TaskDescription_189.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Клан Львинолицых</color> чтобы обсудить растущую угрозу со стороны преступников.

TaskDescription_190.en: For now, take no action and <color=#orange>wait</color> for victory tidings from the Lion-Face Clan.
TaskDescription_190.cn: 暂且按兵不动，<color=#orange>静待</color>狮相门捷报。
TaskDescription_190.ru: На данный момент не предпринимайте никаких действий и <color=#orange>ждать</color> за вестями о победе от клана Львинолицых.

TaskDescription_191.en: Unusual happenings surround the Lion-Face Clan. <color=#orange>Observe closely</color>.
TaskDescription_191.cn: 狮相门近日之事多有蹊跷，<color=#orange>静心留意观察</color>。
TaskDescription_191.ru: Необычные события окружают клан Львинолицых. <color=#orange>Наблюдайте внимательно</color>.

TaskDescription_192.en: <color=#orange>Eliminate</color> <color=#orange>Flying Lion Hall Disciples</color> near the Lion-Face Clan. If it drags on for more than <color=#orange>3 years</color>, the situation will become irreversible!
TaskDescription_192.cn: <color=#orange>尽快消灭</color>狮相门附近的<color=#orange>飞狮堂弟子</color>。若是迁延<color=#orange>超过3年</color>，局势恐将无可挽回！

TaskDescription_193.en: Lion-Face Clan disciples are wiping out <color=#orange>Exotic Fighters</color> near the Lion-Face Clan. <color=#orange>You may aid Lion-Face Clan disciples</color> in eliminating enemies, and compete with the Lion-Face Clan in the number of foes slain.
TaskDescription_193.cn: 狮相门弟子正在剿灭狮相门附近的<color=#orange>异族高手</color>，可选择<color=#orange>帮助狮相门弟子</color>消灭更多敌人，并与狮相门比试杀敌数量。

TaskDescription_194.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for the Lion-Face Clan to banish foreign enemies.
TaskDescription_194.ru: <color=#orange>Ждать</color> чтобы клан Львинолицых изгнал внешних врагов.

TaskDescription_195.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Lion-Face Clan</color> for their victory celebration.
TaskDescription_195.cn: 前往<color=#orange>狮相门</color>参加庆功宴。
TaskDescription_195.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Клан Львинолицых</color> для празднования их победы.

TaskDescription_196.en: Head to <color=#orange>any towns or villages in the Kunlun Mountains</color> and investigate the crime inflicted on the villagers.
TaskDescription_196.cn: 前往<color=#orange>昆仑山任一城镇村寨</color>，探查村民受害之事。

TaskDescription_197.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Vajra Sect</color> and meet the Western Regions Eminent Monk.
TaskDescription_197.cn: 前往<color=#orange>金刚宗</color>，拜访西域高僧。
TaskDescription_197.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Секта Ваджра</color> и познакомьтесь с выдающимся Монахом из Западных краев.

TaskDescription_199.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> and initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Sutra Mystery</color>.
TaskDescription_199.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>{0}</color> и инициировать встречу <color=#orange>Тайна сутры</color>.

TaskDescription_200.en: <color=#orange>Travel through</color> the <color=#orange>Western Regions</color> for an investigation.
TaskDescription_200.cn: 在<color=#orange>西域</color>范围内<color=#orange>四处移动探查</color>。

TaskDescription_201.en: Enter the Taiwu Village Industry page, interact with <color=#orange>Reincarnation Platform</color>, and send the Eminent Monk into one of the paths of reincarnation.
TaskDescription_201.cn: 进入太吾村产业界面，与建筑<color=#orange>「轮回台」</color>互动，将高僧送入任一轮回道。

TaskDescription_202.en: After the Eminent Monk is placed in the Reincarnation Platform, his <color=#orange>reincarnation progress</color> will accrue over time. When it reaches 100%, select <color=#orange>Reincarnation</color> for the Eminent Monk's specific path to finalize the process.
TaskDescription_202.cn: 将高僧送入轮回台后，<color=#orange>轮回进度</color>会随时间累积。待其已满，便可点击高僧所在轮回道下的<color=#orange>「转世」</color>，助高僧轮回。

TaskDescription_203.en: Head to <color=#orange>towns and villages in the Kunlun Mountains</color> to seek a way to aid the Eminent Monk.
TaskDescription_203.cn: 前往<color=#orange>昆仑山地区的城镇村寨</color>，寻找助高僧脱困之法。

TaskDescription_204.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Nirvana Vajra Sect</color> in the Kunlun Mountains to inquire about the Western Regions Eminent Monk. Interact with the <color=#orange>locals</color> for more information.
TaskDescription_204.cn: 前往昆仑山<color=#orange>无量金刚宗</color>，询问西域高僧之事。亦可与<color=#orange>当地居民</color>互动，查问一番。

TaskDescription_205.en: Talk to others and use the <color=#orange>Spread Sutra</color> Secret. Few know of the Eminent Monk's spreading sutra, but as word spreads, it shall be revealed in due time. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for it to be spread from person to person—in just a few months, it will be known to all. Beware the Vajra Sect's covetous gaze—<color=#orange>be cautious</color> when revealing this knowledge.\nDuring this time, you may also converse with the Eminent Monk's spirit at the Reincarnation Platform.
TaskDescription_205.cn: 与其他人物交谈，使用<color=#orange>「传经」</color>秘闻。高僧传经之事罕有，得知秘闻者，或将此事再三远传，如此一来，便可<color=#orange>静待</color>人人口耳相传，不出数月，此秘闻终得公开。金刚宗行事狠恶，又对宝经垂涎已久，或须<color=#orange>谨慎相告</color>。\n传经期间，亦可在轮回台与高僧魂灵对谈。

TaskDescription_206.en: Having not agreed to aid the Vajra Sect in their sutra hunt, <color=#orange>wait for</color> it to conclude.
TaskDescription_206.cn: 未曾应允金刚宗寻经，<color=#orange>静待</color>此事了结。

TaskDescription_208.en: The Vajra Sect has learned of the Eminent Monk's whereabouts. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for what comes next.
TaskDescription_208.cn: 金刚宗已知晓高僧行踪，<color=#orange>静待</color>其变。

TaskDescription_209.en: Talk to the visiting monks from the <color=#orange>Central Plains</color>.
TaskDescription_209.cn: 与来访的<color=#orange>中原僧人</color>对话。
TaskDescription_209.ru: Поговорите с приезжими Монахами из <color=#orange>Центральные равнины</color>.

TaskDescription_210.en: Talk to <color=#orange>Western Regions Eminent Monk</color> and convey the doubts of Eminent Monks from the Central Plains.
TaskDescription_210.cn: 与<color=#orange>西域高僧</color>对话，转达中原诸僧的疑问。

TaskDescription_211.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for the Western Regions Eminent Monk to explain the implication of the sutra.
TaskDescription_211.cn: <color=#orange>等待</color>西域高僧解答经中深意。

TaskDescription_212.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Vajra Sect</color> to conclude the matter of the sutra.
TaskDescription_212.cn: 前往<color=#orange>金刚宗</color>，了结寻经之事。
TaskDescription_212.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Секта Ваджра</color> чтобы завершить тему сутры.

TaskDescription_214.en: The Vajra Sect has obtained the sutra. <color=#orange>Wait </color> for their tidings.
TaskDescription_214.cn: 金刚宗已取得经书，<color=#orange>静待</color>其消息。
TaskDescription_214.ru: Секта Ваджры получила сутру. <color=#orange>Ждать </color> за их вести.

TaskDescription_215.en: Talk to high-ranking figures of the Five Immortals Sect or access the sect's Industry page to interact with the building <color=#orange>Five Venoms Valley</color>. Select Successor of Taiwu for Sect Favor Interaction <color=#orange>Five Venoms Ablution</color>.
TaskDescription_215.cn: 与五仙教上三阶人物对话，或进入五仙教产业界面，点击建筑<color=#orange>「五毒浴谷」</color>，选择太吾传人进行门派恩义互动<color=#orange>「五圣秘浴」</color>。

TaskDescription_216.en: Head to the <color=#orange>vicinity of Valley of Flowers</color> to seek a cure for Ran Xindu.
TaskDescription_216.cn: 前往<color=#orange>百花谷附近</color>，为苒心毒寻医。
TaskDescription_216.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>окрестности Долины цветов</color> чтобы найти лекарство для Ран Синду.

TaskDescription_217.en: Interact with <color=#orange>Ran Xindu</color> near the Five Immortals Sect.
TaskDescription_217.cn: 与位于五仙教附近的<color=#orange>苒心毒</color>互动。
TaskDescription_217.ru: Взаимодействовать с <color=#orange>Ран Синду</color> рядом с Сектой пяти Бессмертных.

TaskDescription_218.en: Head to the <color=#orange>vicinity of Kongsang Sect</color> to seek a cure for Ran Xindu.
TaskDescription_218.cn: 前往<color=#orange>空桑派附近</color>，为苒心毒寻医。
TaskDescription_218.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>окрестности Секты Кунсан</color> чтобы найти лекарство для Ран Синду.

TaskDescription_219.en: Ran Xindu has returned to the Five Immortals Sect. <color=#orange>Wait</color>for her tidings.
TaskDescription_219.cn: 苒心毒已返回五仙教，<color=#orange>静待</color>其消息。
TaskDescription_219.ru: Ран Синду вернулся в Секту пяти Бессмертных. <color=#orange>Ждать</color>за ее вестями.

TaskDescription_220.en: A sliver of hope remains—<color=#orange>wait</color> for Ran Xindu's tidings.
TaskDescription_220.cn: 心中仍存一丝希望，<color=#orange>等待</color>苒心毒的消息。
TaskDescription_220.ru: Остается лучик надежды—<color=#orange>ждать</color> за новости от Ран Синду.

TaskDescription_221.en: Head to the <color=#orange>Five Immortals Sect</color>. Initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Anomalies of the Five Immortals Sect</color>. The Five Immortals Sect is in grave peril. Should you delay <color=#orange>beyond 12 months</color>, the situation may become irreversible!
TaskDescription_221.cn: 前往<color=#orange>五仙教</color>，进入奇遇<color=#orange>「五仙异变」</color>。五仙事态危急，若是迁延<color=#orange>超过12个月</color>，局势恐将无可挽回！

TaskDescription_222.en: <color=#orange>After some time has passed</color>, return to Mt. Emei and investigate <color=#orange>the site of the murder</color>.
TaskDescription_222.cn: <color=#orange>经过些许时日</color>，再回峨眉山<color=#orange>凶案发生之地附近</color>查看情况。

TaskDescription_223.en: Interact with <color=#orange>Emei Sect members</color> to inquire about the <color=#orange>Emer murder case</color> and collect different leads.
TaskDescription_223.cn: 与<color=#orange>峨眉派人物</color>互动，询问<color=#orange>峨眉凶案</color>之事，收集不同的线索。

TaskDescription_224.en: Head to <color=#orange>Mt. Emei</color> and interact with <color=#orange>White Ape</color>.
TaskDescription_224.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Гора Эмэй</color> и взаимодействовать с <color=#orange>Белая обезьяна</color>.

TaskDescription_225.en: <color=#orange>Wait</color> for White Ape's return. In the meantime, interact with <color=#orange>Emei Sect members</color> to inquire about the <color=#orange>reclusive elder</color> and <color=#orange>concerns over sect orthodoxy</color>.
TaskDescription_225.cn: <color=#orange>等待</color>白猿归来。期间可与<color=#orange>峨眉派人物</color>互动，询问<color=#orange>隐居长老</color>与<color=#orange>正宗之忧</color>。

TaskDescription_226.en: Head to Mt. Emei Encounter <color=#orange>True Legacy</color>. The Emei Sect teeters on the brink of disaster—should you delay <color=#orange>beyond 6 months</color>, all may be lost!
TaskDescription_226.cn: 前往峨眉山奇遇<color=#orange>「何为正宗」</color>。峨眉大劫在即，若迁延<color=#orange>超过6个月</color>，局势恐将无可挽回！

TaskDescription_227.en: Internal strife has erupted within the Emei Sect. <color=#orange>Quietly observe the situation </color>.
TaskDescription_227.cn: 峨眉派中内乱已生，<color=#orange>静心留意观察</color>。

TaskDescription_228.en: Head to <color=#orange>Mt. Emei</color> and interact with <color=#orange>Shi Houjiu</color>.
TaskDescription_228.ru: Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Гора Эмэй</color> и взаимодействовать с <color=#orange>Ши Хоуджу</color>.

TaskDescription_229.en: White Ape is no longer here. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for his return.
TaskDescription_229.cn: 白猿已不在旧地，<color=#orange>等候</color>其归来。
TaskDescription_229.ru: Белой обезьяны здесь больше нет. <color=#orange>Ждать</color> за его возвращение.

TaskDescription_230.en: Shi Houjiu is no longer here. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for his return.
TaskDescription_230.cn: 石候酒已不在旧地，<color=#orange>等候</color>其归来。
TaskDescription_230.ru: Ши Хоуджу здесь больше нет. <color=#orange>Ждать</color> за его возвращение.

TaskDescription_709.en: Rumors are spreading throughout Emei, and unrest stirs among its people. <color=#orange>Remain in a secluded area of Mt. Emei</color> for some time and observe how events unfold.
TaskDescription_709.cn: 听闻峨眉流言四起、人心浮动，于<color=#orange>峨眉山远离人烟之处停留</color>些许时日，静观其变。

TaskDescription_710.en: The truth behind the turmoil at Emei remains unclear. Move about and investigate within <color=#orange>Mt. Emei</color>; an opportunity may present itself.
TaskDescription_710.cn: 峨眉风波真相未明，于<color=#orange>峨眉山</color>移动查探，或能得遇一番机缘。

TaskDescription_711.en: A storm seems to be brewing in Mt. Emei. <color=#orange>Remain in a secluded area of Mt. Emei</color> for some time.
TaskDescription_711.cn: 峨眉山中似有风雨欲来之势，于<color=#orange>峨眉山远离人烟之处停留</color>些许时日。

TaskDescription_712.en: The unrest at Emei appears to be escalating. For now, <color=#orange>wait</color> a while longer; the situation may soon change.
TaskDescription_712.cn: 峨眉风波似已愈演愈烈，暂且<color=#orange>静待</color>些许时日，局势或将有变。

TaskDescription_713.en: Something is amiss. Head to the <color=#orange>Emei Sect</color> immediately.
TaskDescription_713.cn: 事有蹊跷，立刻前往<color=#orange>峨眉派</color>中。
TaskDescription_713.ru: Что-то здесь не так. Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Секта Эмэй</color> немедленно.

TaskDescription_714.en: The Jinding Arena is now unavoidable. At the Sect Leader's request, help the Emei Sect <color=#orange>prepare for the tournament</color>.
TaskDescription_714.cn: 金顶比武已势在必行，受掌门之托，助峨眉派<color=#orange>预备比武</color>。

TaskDescription_715.en: Go find the <color=#orange>Five Groups of Emei Disciples</color>, click the <color=#orange>Emei Martial Arts icon on the map</color>, and provide them with <color=#orange>Martial Arts Guidance</color>.
TaskDescription_715.cn: 前往寻找<color=#orange>五路峨眉弟子</color>，点击<color=#orange>地图上的峨眉功法图标</color>，为其<color=#orange>指点武学</color>。

TaskDescription_716.en: Before the Jinding competition, go find <color=#orange>White Ape</color> and inform him about the Jinding competition...
TaskDescription_716.cn: 在金顶比武来临之前，前往寻找<color=#orange>白猿</color>，告知金顶比武一事……

TaskDescription_717.en: Xiao Shi seems to have an unusual expression; before the Jinding competition, interact with <color=#orange>Xiao Shi</color> to find out what's going on.
TaskDescription_717.cn: 小石神情似有异常，在金顶比武来临之前，与<color=#orange>小石</color>互动，一问究竟……

TaskDescription_718.en: During the arena preparations, interact with <color=#orange>Emei Sect members</color> within the sect to inquire about <color=#orange>Emei Orthodoxy</color> and their <color=#orange>cultivation progress</color>.
TaskDescription_718.cn: 预备比武期间，可于峨眉派中与<color=#orange>峨眉派人物</color>互动，询问<color=#orange>峨眉正统</color>与<color=#orange>修炼情况</color>。

TaskDescription_719.en: During the arena preparations, interact with <color=#orange>non-sect characters</color> in the Bashu region to inquire about <color=#orange>Emei Orthodoxy</color>.
TaskDescription_719.cn: 预备比武期间，可于巴蜀地区与<color=#orange>非门派人物</color>互动，询问<color=#orange>峨眉正统</color>。

TaskDescription_720.en: The day of the Jinding Arena has arrived. Head to the <color=#orange>Emei Sect</color> immediately.
TaskDescription_720.cn: 金顶比武之期已至，立刻前往<color=#orange>峨眉派</color>中。
TaskDescription_720.ru: Настал день Джиндинг-арены. Направляйтесь к <color=#orange>Секта Эмэй</color> немедленно.

TaskDescription_731.en: The Jinding competition has settled, but the matter of the patriarch's manual has become increasingly confusing. For now, <color=#orange>wait</color> a while longer, then return to Emei to investigate.
TaskDescription_731.cn: 金顶比武尘埃落定，祖师秘籍之事却愈发扑朔迷离，暂且<color=#orange>静待</color>些许时日，再返峨眉查探。

TaskDescription_721.en: The Emei Sect has recently finished its rest. Wander through the <color=#orange>Emei Sect</color> and investigate. Interact with <color=#orange>Emei Sect members</color> to learn about the sect's current situation.
TaskDescription_721.cn: 峨眉派日前休整已毕，于<color=#orange>峨眉派</color>内漫步查探，与<color=#orange>峨眉派人物</color>互动，探明峨眉派现状。

TaskDescription_722.en: The mysterious evil demon's whereabouts are unknown. Leave the <color=#orange>Emei Sect</color> for now and seek out the White Ape.
TaskDescription_722.cn: 神秘恶妖眼下行踪不明，暂且离开<color=#orange>峨眉派</color>，前去寻找白猿。

TaskDescription_723.en: Interact with the <color=#orange>White Ape</color> and ask about the demon tribes of Mt. Emei.
TaskDescription_723.cn: 与<color=#orange>白猿</color>互动，询问峨眉山妖族之事。
TaskDescription_723.ru: Взаимодействовать с <color=#orange>Белая обезьяна</color> и спросите о демонических племенах горы Эмэй.

TaskDescription_724.en: Little Shi and the mysterious evil demon have both vanished without a trace. The situation grows increasingly strange. Interact with the <color=#orange>White Ape</color> and <color=#orange>search for the Yaoguai</color> together. During the search, you may <color=#orange>chat with the White Ape</color> to learn more about the Demon.
TaskDescription_724.cn: 小石与那神秘恶妖尽皆行踪不明，事态诡秘，与<color=#orange>白猿</color>互动，一同前去与<color=#orange>探寻妖族</color>。探寻期间可与白猿<color=#orange>闲聊一二</color>，了解些许妖族之事。

TaskDescription_725.en: While tracking the evil Yaoguai, interact with <color=#orange>Emei Sect members</color> within the sect to inquire about <color=#orange>recent events in Emei</color> and the <color=#orange>demon of the mountains</color>.
TaskDescription_725.cn: 追踪恶妖期间，可于峨眉派中与<color=#orange>峨眉派人物</color>互动，询问<color=#orange>峨眉近况</color>与<color=#orange>山中妖族</color>。

TaskDescription_726.en: Shi Houjiu has launched an attack on the Emei Sect. Head to the <color=#orange>Emei Sect</color> at once!
TaskDescription_726.cn: 石候酒已向峨眉派袭去，即刻赶往<color=#orange>峨眉派</color>！

TaskDescription_727.en: Everything here is drawing to a close, and the heroes of the realm will soon part ways. After interacting with Li Zihua, <color=#orange>wait</color> a while longer and bring this chance encounter to its conclusion.
TaskDescription_727.cn: 此间诸事已了，各路群侠终将各奔西东，与李自华互动后，<color=#orange>静待</color>些许时日，了却此番萍水相逢之缘。

TaskDescription_728.en: Wander through <color=#orange>Mt. Emei</color> and witness the mountain as it stands today.
TaskDescription_728.cn: 在<color=#orange>峨眉山</color>漫步移动，见证峨眉山如今光景。
TaskDescription_728.ru: Бродить по <color=#orange>Гора Эмэй</color> и посмотрите на гору такой, какой она является сегодня.

TaskDescription_729.en: The truth behind the Patriarch's Manual has been revealed, and the turmoil within the Emei Sect has come to an end. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for further news from the Emei Sect.
TaskDescription_729.cn: 祖师秘籍真相水落石出，峨眉派风波皆已平息，<color=#orange>静待</color>峨眉派此后消息。

TaskDescription_231.en: Move to the tile of the <color=#orange>Fuyu Hilt</color>.
TaskDescription_231.cn: 移动至<color=#orange>伏虞剑柄</color>所在地格。

TaskDescription_232.en: Head to the Taiwu Village's region and move to the tile <color=#orange>Return the Pearl and the Jade</color>. Click the icon to pick up the abandoned <color=#orange>travel bag</color>.
TaskDescription_232.cn: 前往太吾村所在地区，移动至<color=#orange>「还珠返璧」</color>图标所在地格，点击图标，以捡拾委弃的<color=#orange>行囊</color>。

TaskDescription_233.en: Head to the Taiwu Village region and move to the tile <color=#orange>Revisit Old Skills</color>. Click the icon to retrieve the removed <color=#orange>Fine Arts</color>.
TaskDescription_233.cn: 前往太吾村所在地区，移动至<color=#orange>「重温旧艺」</color>图标所在地格，点击图标，以取回祛除的<color=#orange>技艺</color>。

TaskDescription_234.en: Head to the Taiwu Village region and move to the tile <color=#orange>Echoes of Knowledge</color>. Click the icon to reclaim the removed <color=#orange>Martial Art</color>.
TaskDescription_234.cn: 前往太吾村所在地区，移动至<color=#orange>「鉴往知来」</color>图标所在地格，点击图标，以重获废去的<color=#orange>功法</color>。

TaskDescription_235.en: Return to <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color> to check it out.
TaskDescription_235.ru: Вернуться к <color=#orange>Деревня Тайу</color> чтобы проверить это.

TaskDescription_236.en: Head to various regions to challenge the Divine Loong and use <color=#orange>Golden Thread</color> to subdue it.
TaskDescription_236.cn: 前往世界各地挑战神龙，并使用<color=#orange>「一缕金丝」</color>降伏神龙。

TaskDescription_237.en: Enter the building <color=#orange>Taiwu Village</color> in the center of Taiwu Village Industry screen, then raise Jiao in the <color=#orange>Jiao Pool</color>
TaskDescription_237.cn: 进入太吾村产业界面中央的建筑<color=#orange>「太吾村」</color>，在<color=#orange>「蛟池」</color>中养育长蛟。

TaskDescription_238.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> to challenge <color=#orange>White Loong</color> on the tile of <color=#orange>Thunder Marsh</color>.
TaskDescription_238.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，挑战位于<color=#orange>雷泽</color>地格上的<color=#orange>白龙</color>。

TaskDescription_239.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> to challenge <color=#orange>Black Loong</color> on the tile of <color=#orange>Flood Marsh</color>.
TaskDescription_239.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，挑战位于<color=#orange>洪泽</color>地格上的<color=#orange>黑龙</color>。

TaskDescription_240.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> to challenge <color=#orange>Green Loong</color> on the tile of <color=#orange>Wind Marsh</color>.
TaskDescription_240.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，挑战位于<color=#orange>风泽</color>地格上的<color=#orange>青龙</color>。

TaskDescription_241.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> to challenge <color=#orange>Red Loong</color> on the tile of <color=#orange>Flame Marsh</color>.
TaskDescription_241.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，挑战位于<color=#orange>炎泽</color>地格上的<color=#orange>赤龙</color>。

TaskDescription_242.en: Head to <color=#orange>{0}</color> to challenge <color=#orange>Yellow Loong</color> on the tile of <color=#orange>Sand Marsh</color>.
TaskDescription_242.cn: 前往<color=#orange>{0}</color>，挑战位于<color=#orange>沙泽</color>地格上的<color=#orange>黄龙</color>。

TaskDescription_243.en:
<color=#orange>Place the [Jiao Egg]</color> in the Jiao Pool, <color=#orange>choose a nurturing policy</color>, and begin the raising process.
During this time, <color=#orange>resources will be consumed each month</color> according to the chosen policy.
If the Jiao's <color=#orange>Tameness</color> is too low, it may escape. You need to head to Jiao's tile in the <color=#orange>Taiwu Village region</color>, <color=#orange> capture the Jiao in battle with ropes</color>, and put it back into the pool.
Once raised, <color=#orange> the Jiao may leave the pool</color> and serve as a vehicle.
TaskDescription_243.cn:
在蛟池中<color=#orange>投入「蛟卵」</color>，并<color=#orange>选择养育方针</color>后，即可开始养育。
养育期间，根据当前的养育方针，<color=#orange>每月将消耗一定资源</color>。
如果长蛟的<color=#orange>驯服度</color>过低，有可能逃离蛟池；需前往<color=#orange>太吾村地区</color>长蛟所在地格，<color=#orange>在战斗中用绳子抓捕</color>后，重新放入蛟池。
养育完成后，可令<color=#orange>长蛟离池</color>，成为代步。

TaskDescription_244.en: After the Jiao is raised, two Jiao of opposite genders may <color=#orange>breed</color> and produce new <color=#orange>Jiao Eggs</color>.\nJiao with higher attributes can be obtained via nurturing and breeding. When <color=#orange>a Jiao's attribute reaches its peak</color> and <color=#orange>any other two are excellent</color>, you may attempt to <color=#orange>Ascend to Loong</color> <color=#orange>in the bottom-right corner of the Jiao Pool page</color>.
TaskDescription_244.cn: 长蛟养育完成后，两条异性蛟可以进行<color=#orange>繁育</color>，并产下新的<color=#orange>「蛟卵」</color>。\n通过培养和繁育，可以不断获得属性更高的长蛟；当长蛟的<color=#orange>一项属性达到极致</color>，且<color=#orange>其余任意两项属性出众</color>时，便可于<color=#orange>蛟池界面右下角</color>，尝试<color=#orange>「化为龙子」</color>。

TaskDescription_245.en: The Five Immortals Sect is rife with peril and uncertainty. <color=#orange>Caution is a must when moving around</color>.
TaskDescription_245.cn: 五仙教诡事众多，须得<color=#orange>在附近谨慎前行</color>。

TaskDescription_246.en: Interact with <color=#orange>Five Immortals Sect members</color> about the Gu poison.
TaskDescription_246.cn: 与<color=#orange>五仙教人物</color>互动，询问蛊毒之事。
TaskDescription_246.ru: Взаимодействовать с <color=#orange>Члены Секты пяти бессмертных</color> насчет Яда Гу.

TaskDescription_247.en: Talk to high-ranking figures of the Five Immortals Sect or access the sect's Industry page to interact with the building <color=#orange>Five Venoms Valley</color>. Select Successor of Taiwu for Sect Favor Interaction <color=#orange>Five Venoms Ablution</color>.
TaskDescription_247.cn: 与五仙教上三阶人物对话，或进入五仙教产业界面，点击建筑<color=#orange>「五毒浴谷」</color>，选择太吾传人进行门派恩义互动<color=#orange>「五圣秘浴」</color>。

TaskDescription_248.en: The occurrences in the Five Venoms Valley are indeed strange. Better to <color=#orange>wait</color> and see how it unfolds.
TaskDescription_248.cn: 五毒浴谷之事颇为奇异，不如<color=#orange>静待</color>些许时日，以观其变。

TaskDescription_249.en: I have yet to answer the Divine Matron's request. <color=#orange>Wait</color> for it to conclude.
TaskDescription_249.cn: 未曾应允圣姑之请，<color=#orange>静待</color>此事了结。
TaskDescription_249.ru: Я еще не ответил на просьбу Божественной матроны. <color=#orange>Ждать</color> чтобы это завершилось.

TaskDescription_250.en: Head to <color=#orange>Valley of Flowers</color> and initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Panwang Festival</color>.
TaskDescription_250.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「百花谷」</color>，进入奇遇<color=#orange>「跳盘王」</color>。

TaskDescription_251.en: Interact with <color=#orange>high-ranking members in the Valley of Flowers</color> about Ran Xindu's illness.
TaskDescription_251.cn: 与<color=#orange>百花谷上三阶人物</color>互动，询问苒心毒病症。

TaskDescription_252.en: Head to <color=#orange>Mt. Kongsang</color> and initiate the Encounter <color=#orange>Starry Festival</color>.
TaskDescription_252.cn: 前往<color=#orange>「空桑山」</color>，进入奇遇<color=#orange>「祭星典」</color>。

TaskDescription_253.en: Interact with <color=#orange>high-ranking members in the Kongsang Sect</color> about Ran Xindu's illness.
TaskDescription_253.cn: 与<color=#orange>空桑派上三阶人物</color>互动，询问苒心毒病症。
